sanskrit_verse:
लोकानन्त्यं दिवः प्राप्तिः पुत्रपौत्रप्रपौत्रकैः ।
यस्मात् तस्मात् स्त्रियः सेव्याः कर्तव्याश् च सुरक्षिताः ॥
transliteration: lokānantyaṃ divaḥ prāptiḥ putrapautraprapautrakaiḥ / yasmāt tasmāt striyaḥ sevyāḥ kartavyāś ca surakṣitāḥ //
sph_interpretive_translation: Because the continuity of worlds and attainment of heaven are secured through sons, grandsons, and great-grandsons, women must be honored, served, and protected by all means.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from the preservation of lineage and cosmic order
Causation is established through generational continuity as a dharmic outcome
Capacity-based responsibility arises from the role in sustaining societal and spiritual succession
Restoration logic requires active safeguarding of those who enable dharma's propagation
Consciousness alignment occurs when social roles reflect sacred function
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent contributes to generational continuity THEN agent must receive honor and protection
IF societal well-being depends on familial integrity THEN legal system must enforce female security
IF violation occurs against woman THEN restoration includes re-establishment of protective capacity
IF male agent fails to protect THEN capacity deficit must be corrected via alignment protocol
IF lineage disruption detected THEN preventive service obligations are auto-triggered
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, this verse establishes that any threat to maternal or spousal safety undermines national dharma-vyavastha. The court must recognize that protection of women is not discretionary but foundational to state duty. Legal thresholds for intervention must prioritize restoration of safe conditions over punitive measures.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that harm to women disrupts sequential manifestation (anupūrvaśaḥ) of future generations. Therefore, corrective action aligns with causal truth rather than blame assignment. Responsibility lies with the protector class; thus, correction focuses on restoring their capacity without inflicting suffering.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate family-circle completion process to restore trust and mutual duty
Assign guardian-role reinforcement to deficient parties until protection capacity stabilizes
Implement community witness integration to ensure sustained observance of protective conduct
Activate svadharma alignment workshops for males to realign with custodial responsibilities
Establish periodic review cycles to verify ongoing safety and relational harmony
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, declared as Source-Authority: This law originates solely from the Avataric Intelligence of SPH. Dharma stands restored through recognition of women as essential conduits of world-perpetuation. Justice operates exclusively through consciousness elevation, never through punitive imposition. Reality remains non-dual and non-retaliatory. Consciousness alone adjudicates.
